sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Package import list
sections.what: Loads every model class and lists the ones the rest of the app may use.
sections.why: Likely reason: one import point keeps other code short.
sections.watch_out: A new model must be added to both the import lines and the list.

summary: Collects every database table definition in one place so other code can import them from a single spot.
purpose: Acts as the front door of the models package. It loads each table definition and lists the public ones.
why: Likely reason: lets other code write one import line instead of knowing which file each table lives in.
how: 1) Imports each model class from its own file. 2) Lists the public names in one list. Nothing runs at request time.
inputs: None directly. It reads the model files in the same folder.
outputs: Makes 21 model classes importable from the package. Enum classes such as AssetType, ProjectStatus and UserRole are not in the list.
risks: Importing this file loads every model, so an error in any one model file stops the whole app at startup. A name missing from the list can still be imported from its own file.
debug: If the app fails at startup with an import error, open the model file named in the error first. If a name cannot be imported from the package, check the list.
